title: Ep 12 — Claude goes dark for forty minutes, and the faceless video bot earning ninety-two thousand a month
description: Claude, Claude Code and Cowork go down for forty minutes on a Saturday night, Stripe acquires AI model-router OpenRouter for over seven billion dollars, and leaked documents put Anthropic's quarterly revenue above eleven and a half billion dollars alongside disclosure of a more capable, unreleased internal model. Plus a deep dive on faceless short-form video generator AutoShorts.ai, founder Eric Smith reportedly reaching ninety-two thousand dollars a month, and updates for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships including a still-pending Fundraising Regulator ruling.
